independent_checks.no_free_lunch_proof: Independently rederived: for V(q;A)=sum_i A_i/q_i, choose A=e_i. Uniform V(q;A)<=V(q0;A) gives q_i>=q0_i for every i. Positive simplex sums then force equality coordinatewise, q=q0. The worker theorem is exact under its stated unrestricted nonnegative-A scope.
independent_checks.first_change_corollary: If two environments share all past observables but permit arbitrary next A after the predictable allocation is fixed, the same q must serve both; the theorem implies no nontrivial q can have deterministic q0-noninferiority for all such next A. This is a deterministic worst-case statement, not a claim against probabilistic/bounded-drift guarantees.
independent_checks.conditional_box_rule: If true A is inside the uncertainty box and the controller selects q only when max_{A in box}[V(q;A)-V(q0;A)]<=0, then realized degradation is <=0 by set inclusion. Therefore conditional-on-coverage false upgrades are mathematically excluded apart from implementation/numerical error.
